bios.short_bio: Mira Sol is an independent producer based in Montreal, building tracks from field recordings and hardware synths.
bios.long_bio: I’m Mira Sol, an independent producer based in Montreal, building tracks from field recordings and hardware synths. My sound moves through deep house and downtempo, with influences from Four Tet and early Bonobo. I’m drawn to warm, nocturnal, reflective moods.
bios.track_description: “Glass Tides” is a deep house / downtempo track with a warm, nocturnal, reflective mood. Released November 7, 2026.
